param float decimRate = 8.0 [1.0, 32.0]
param float bitDepth = 6.0 [2.0, 16.0]
param float jitter = 0.20 [0.0, 1.0]
param float drive = 1.5 [1.0, 4.0]
param float mix = 0.75 [0.0, 1.0]
state float holdAccum = 0
state float heldSample = 0
state float noiseState = 0.12345
state float lp = 0

noiseState = (noiseState * 196314.165 + 90763.3) % 1.0
rnd = noiseState * 2.0 - 1.0

stepThreshold = max(1.0, decimRate * (1.0 + rnd * jitter * 0.4))
holdAccum = holdAccum + 1.0
heldSample = if(holdAccum >= stepThreshold, in * drive, heldSample)
holdAccum = if(holdAccum >= stepThreshold, 0.0, holdAccum)

bits = clamp(bitDepth, 2.0, 16.0)
levels = pow(2.0, bits)
quantized = round(heldSample * levels) / levels

crushed = quantized / (1.0 + abs(quantized) * 0.18)
lp = lp + 0.55 * (crushed - lp)

out = in * (1.0 - mix) + lp * mix

param float drive = 3.0 [1.0, 10.0]
param float tone = 4000.0 [400.0, 12000.0]
param float bias = 0.20 [0.0, 0.8]
param float mix = 1.0 [0.0, 1.0]
state float lp = 0

x = in * drive + bias
sat = x / (1.0 + abs(x)) - bias * 0.5

f = clamp((tone / sr) * 3.14159, 0.001, 0.95)
lp = lp + f * (sat - lp)

wet = lp
out = in * (1.0 - mix) + wet * mix

param float grainSize = 0.5 [0.05, 0.95]
param float pitch = 1.0 [0.25, 2.0]
param float spray = 0.4 [0.0, 1.0]
param float wet = 0.8 [0.0, 1.0]
state float buf[2048] = 0.0
state float wpos = 0.0
state float ph0 = 0.0
state float ph1 = 0.333
state float ph2 = 0.667

buf[wpos] = in
grainLen = 64.0 + grainSize * 1900.0
inc = pitch / grainLen

ph0 = ph0 + inc
ph0 = ph0 - floor(ph0)
ph1 = ph1 + inc
ph1 = ph1 - floor(ph1)
ph2 = ph2 + inc
ph2 = ph2 - floor(ph2)

win0 = 1.0 - abs(ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0)
win1 = 1.0 - abs(ph1 * 2.0 - 1.0)
win2 = 1.0 - abs(ph2 * 2.0 - 1.0)

back0 = grainLen * (1.0 + (ph0 - 0.5) * spray)
back1 = grainLen * (1.0 + (ph1 - 0.5) * spray)
back2 = grainLen * (1.0 + (ph2 - 0.5) * spray)

idx0 = (wpos - back0 + 8192.0) % 2048.0
idx1 = (wpos - back1 + 8192.0) % 2048.0
idx2 = (wpos - back2 + 8192.0) % 2048.0

g0 = buf[idx0] * win0
g1 = buf[idx1] * win1
g2 = buf[idx2] * win2

wetSig = (g0 + g1 + g2) * 0.6
wpos = (wpos + 1.0) % 2048.0
out = in * (1.0 - wet) + wetSig * wet

param float loop = 0.12 [0.01, 0.33]
param float pitch = 1.0 [0.25, 2.0]
param float freeze = 0.0 [0.0, 1.0]
param float mix = 1.0 [0.0, 1.0]
state float buf[16384] = 0.0
state float wpos = 0.0
state float rpos = 0.0

len = clamp(floor(loop * sr), 64.0, 16384.0)
old = buf[wpos % len]
buf[wpos % len] = old + (in - old) * (1.0 - clamp(freeze, 0.0, 1.0))
wpos = (wpos + 1.0) % len

rpos = (rpos + clamp(pitch, 0.05, 4.0)) % len
i0 = floor(rpos)
frac = rpos - i0
a = buf[i0]
b = buf[(i0 + 1.0) % len]
grain = a + (b - a) * frac
win = 0.5 - 0.5 * cos(6.283185 * (rpos / len))
wet = grain * (0.35 + 0.65 * win)

out = in * (1.0 - mix) + wet * mix

param float rate = 0.25 [0.02, 3.0]
param float depthMs = 2.5 [0.2, 6.0]
param float feedback = 0.5 [0.0, 0.95]
param float mix = 0.5 [0.0, 1.0]
state float buf[600] = 0.0
state float wpos = 0.0

phase = (phase + rate / sr) % 1.0
lfo = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(6.283185 * phase)

baseMs = 0.3
delaySamples = clamp((baseMs + lfo * depthMs) * 0.001 * sr, 1.0, 590.0)
rpos = (wpos - delaySamples + 1200.0) % 600.0
i0 = floor(rpos)
frac = rpos - i0
a = buf[i0]
b = buf[(i0 + 1.0) % 600.0]
readVal = a + (b - a) * frac

buf[wpos] = in + readVal * feedback
wpos = (wpos + 1.0) % 600.0

out = in * (1.0 - mix) + readVal * mix

state float wc2 = 0.0

state float a2[341] = 0.0
state float wa1 = 0.0

len2 = clamp(floor(1601.0 * size), 200.0, 1601.0)
len3 = clamp(floor(2053.0 * size), 200.0, 2053.0)

i1 = wc1 % len1
y1 = c1[i1]
lp1 = lp1 + (1.0 - damp) * (y1 - lp1)
c1[i1] = in + lp1 * decay
wc1 = (wc1 + 1.0) % 1687.0

i2 = wc2 % len2
y2 = c2[i2]
lp2 = lp2 + (1.0 - damp) * (y2 - lp2)
c2[i2] = in + lp2 * decay

y3 = c3[i3]
lp3 = lp3 + (1.0 - damp) * (y3 - lp3)
c3[i3] = in + lp3 * decay
wc3 = (wc3 + 1.0) % 2053.0

combSum = (y1 + y2 + y3) * 0.33

g = 0.5
r1 = a1[wa1]
ap1 = -g * combSum + r1
a1[wa1] = combSum + g * r1
wa1 = (wa1 + 1.0) % 225.0

r2 = a2[wa2]
ap2 = -g * ap1 + r2
a2[wa2] = ap1 + g * r2
wa2 = (wa2 + 1.0) % 341.0

param float time = 0.18 [0.02, 0.25]
param float feedback = 0.35 [0.0, 0.9]
param float damp = 0.5 [0.0, 1.0]
param float wet = 0.6 [0.0, 1.0]

state float wpos = 0.0
state float lp = 0.0

base = clamp(time * sr, 4.0, 11999.0)
t1 = base * 0.375
t2 = base * 0.5
t3 = base * 0.75
t4 = base

i1 = (wpos - t1 + 48000.0) % 12000.0
i2 = (wpos - t2 + 48000.0) % 12000.0
i3 = (wpos - t3 + 48000.0) % 12000.0
i4 = (wpos - t4 + 48000.0) % 12000.0

s1 = buf[i1] * 0.9
s2 = buf[i2] * 0.7
s3 = buf[i3] * 0.55
s4 = buf[i4] * 0.4
tapsSum = s1 + s2 + s3 + s4

f = clamp(1.0 - damp, 0.02, 1.0) * 0.5
lp = lp + f * (tapsSum - lp)

buf[wpos] = in + lp * feedback
wpos = (wpos + 1.0) % 12000.0

wetSig = tapsSum * 0.5
out = in * (1.0 - wet) + wetSig * wet

param float timeMs = 180.0 [20.0, 240.0]
param float feedback = 0.55 [0.0, 0.95]
param float tone = 3200.0 [500.0, 10000.0]
param float mix = 0.45 [0.0, 1.0]

param float vowel = 0.3 [0.0, 1.0]
param float q = 7.0 [1.5, 14.0]
param float wet = 1.0 [0.0, 1.0]
state float bp1 = 0.0
state float lp1 = 0.0
state float bp2 = 0.0
state float lp2 = 0.0
state float bp3 = 0.0
state float lp3 = 0.0

f1 = mix(700.0, 270.0, vowel)
f2 = mix(1220.0, 2290.0, vowel)
f3 = mix(2600.0, 3010.0, vowel)

w1 = clamp((f1 / sr) * 5.5, 0.01, 0.45)
w2 = clamp((f2 / sr) * 5.5, 0.01, 0.45)
w3 = clamp((f3 / sr) * 5.5, 0.01, 0.45)
r = 1.0 / max(q, 1.0)

hp1 = in - lp1 - r * bp1
bp1 = bp1 + w1 * hp1
lp1 = lp1 + w1 * bp1

hp2 = in - lp2 - r * bp2
bp2 = bp2 + w2 * hp2
lp2 = lp2 + w2 * bp2

hp3 = in - lp3 - r * bp3
bp3 = bp3 + w3 * hp3
lp3 = lp3 + w3 * bp3

wetSig = (bp1 * 1.0 + bp2 * 0.7 + bp3 * 0.5) * 0.6

Field Synth:
param float decay = 0.45 [0.1, 1.5]
param float punch = 5.0 [1.0, 10.0]
param float punchDecay = 0.025 [0.005, 0.1]
param float click = 0.6 [0.0, 1.0]
param float drive = 2.5 [1.0, 6.0]
state float env = 0.0
state float pEnv = 0.0
state float phase = 0.0
state float clickOsc = 0.0

dCoeff = clamp(1.0 - 1.0 / (sr * max(decay, 0.05)), 0.99, 0.99999)
pCoeff = clamp(1.0 - 1.0 / (sr * max(punchDecay, 0.002)), 0.9, 0.999)

env = if(noteOn > 0.5, noteVel, env * dCoeff)
pEnv = if(noteOn > 0.5, 1.0, pEnv * pCoeff)
clickOsc = if(noteOn > 0.5, noteVel * click, clickOsc * 0.85)

basePitch = clamp(notePitch, 35.0, 120.0)
curFreq = basePitch * (1.0 + pEnv * punch)
phase = (phase + curFreq / sr) % 1.0

body = sin(6.283185 * phase)
clickTone = sin(6.283185 * phase * 8.0) * clickOsc
sig = (body + clickTone) * env * drive
sat = sig / (1.0 + abs(sig) * 0.6)
out = sat

param float detune = 1.008 [1.0, 1.03]
param float cutoff = 2800.0 [200.0, 10000.0]
param float res = 0.35 [0.0, 0.92]
param float sub = 0.30 [0.0, 1.0]
param float warmth = 0.40 [0.0, 1.0]
param float attack = 0.05 [0.005, 0.5]
state float p1 = 0
state float p2 = 0
state float pSub = 0
state float env = 0
state float lp = 0

p1 = (p1 + freq / sr) % 1.0
p2 = (p2 + (freq * detune) / sr) % 1.0
pSub = (pSub + (freq * 0.5) / sr) % 1.0

target = if(gate > 0.5, 1.0, 0.0)
rate = if(target > env, clamp(1.0 / (sr * max(attack, 0.005)), 0.0001, 0.1), 0.0005)
env = env + (target - env) * rate

tone = sin(6.283185 * p1) * 0.45 + sin(6.283185 * p2) * 0.45 + sin(6.283185 * pSub) * sub
drive = 1.0 + warmth * 1.5
sat = (tone * drive) / (1.0 + abs(tone * drive * 0.5))

f = clamp((cutoff / sr) * 3.14159, 0.001, 0.95)
lp = lp + f * (sat - lp)
filt = lp + (sat - lp) * (1.0 - res)
out = filt * env

param float tilt = 1.25 [0.4, 3.0]
param float oddEven = 0.5 [0.0, 1.0]
param float shimmer = 0.35 [0.0, 1.0]
param float decay = 2.2 [0.1, 6.0]
param float warmth = 1.35 [1.0, 3.5]
state float phase = 0
state float ampEnv = 0
state float tiltEnv = 0
state float lp = 0

target = if(gate > 0.5, 1.0, 0.0)
ampDecayRate = clamp(1.0 / (sr * decay), 0.00002, 0.02)
tiltDecayRate = clamp(1.0 / (sr * (decay * 0.6)), 0.00003, 0.025)
ampEnv = if(target > ampEnv, ampEnv + (target - ampEnv) * 0.18, ampEnv - ampEnv * ampDecayRate)
tiltEnv = if(target > tiltEnv, tiltEnv + (target - tiltEnv) * 0.22, tiltEnv - tiltEnv * tiltDecayRate)

f0 = clamp(freq, 20.0, 5000.0)
step = f0 / sr
phase = (phase + step) % 1.0

curTilt = tilt + tiltEnv * 0.45
evenScale = (1.0 - oddEven) * 2.0
oddScale = oddEven * 2.0

h1 = sin(6.2831853 * phase) * oddScale
h2 = sin(12.5663706 * phase) * (pow(2.0, -curTilt) * evenScale)
h3 = sin(18.8495559 * phase) * (pow(3.0, -curTilt) * oddScale)
h4 = sin(25.1327412 * phase) * (pow(4.0, -curTilt) * evenScale)
h5 = sin(31.4159265 * phase) * (pow(5.0, -curTilt) * oddScale)
h6 = sin(37.6991118 * phase) * (pow(6.0, -curTilt) * evenScale)
h7 = sin(43.9822971 * phase) * (pow(7.0, -curTilt) * (oddScale + shimmer * 1.5))
h8 = sin(50.2654824 * phase) * (pow(8.0, -curTilt) * (evenScale + shimmer * 1.5))

raw = (h1 + h2 + h3 + h4 + h5 + h6 + h7 + h8) * (warmth * 0.55)
sat = raw / (1.0 + abs(raw) * 0.22)

lp = lp + 0.42 * (sat - lp)
out = lp * ampEnv * 0.52

param float tineDecay = 1.8 [0.3, 4.0]
param float bellAmt = 0.7 [0.0, 2.0]
param float tremoloRate = 4.5 [0.5, 10.0]
param float tremoloDepth = 0.35 [0.0, 0.8]
param float drive = 1.6 [1.0, 4.0]
state float pTine = 0.0
state float pBell = 0.0
state float env = 0.0
state float bellEnv = 0.0
state float tremPhase = 0.0

dCoeff = clamp(1.0 - 1.0 / (sr * max(tineDecay, 0.1)), 0.99, 0.99999)
bCoeff = clamp(1.0 - 1.0 / (sr * 0.35), 0.9, 0.9995)

env = if(noteOn > 0.5, noteVel, env * dCoeff)
bellEnv = if(noteOn > 0.5, noteVel * bellAmt, bellEnv * bCoeff)

pTine = (pTine + freq / sr) % 1.0
pBell = (pBell + (freq * 4.01) / sr) % 1.0

tine = sin(6.283185 * pTine)
bell = sin(6.283185 * pBell) * bellEnv
tone = (tine + bell) * env * drive
pickupSat = tone / (1.0 + abs(tone) * 0.4)

tremPhase = (tremPhase + tremoloRate / sr) % 1.0
trem = 1.0 - (sin(6.283185 * tremPhase) * 0.5 + 0.5) * tremoloDepth

damp = if(gate > 0.5, 1.0, 0.998)
out = pickupSat * trem * damp

param float rMajor = 1.4 [0.5, 4.0]
param float tubeR = 0.15 [0.02, 0.5]
param float speed = 1.0 [0.0, 5.0]
phi = uv.x * 6.2831853
theta = uv.y * 6.2831853
tVal = phi + (t + 1.0) * speed
cx = sin(tVal) + 2.0 * sin(2.0 * tVal)
cy = cos(tVal) - 2.0 * cos(2.0 * tVal)
cz = -sin(3.0 * tVal)
center = vec3(cx, cy, cz) * (rMajor * 0.35)
normalX = cos(theta) * tubeR
normalY = sin(theta) * tubeR
P = center + vec3(normalX, normalY, normalX * 0.5)
N = normalize(P - center)
Cd = vec3(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(tVal * 2.0), 0.4 + 0.4 * cos(theta), 0.9)
publish = sin((t + 1.0) * speed)

param float size = 1.2 [0.2, 3.0]
param float squareness = 4.0 [0.5, 8.0]
param float speed = 1.0 [0.0, 5.0]
phi = uv.x * 6.2831853
theta = (uv.y - 0.5) * 3.14159265
cosP = cos(phi)
sinP = sin(phi)
cosT = cos(theta)
sinT = sin(theta)
signP = if(cosP >= 0.0, 1.0, -1.0)
signSP = if(sinP >= 0.0, 1.0, -1.0)
signT = if(cosT >= 0.0, 1.0, -1.0)
signST = if(sinT >= 0.0, 1.0, -1.0)
e = 2.0 / squareness
x = signT * pow(abs(cosT), e) * signP * pow(abs(cosP), e) * size
z = signT * pow(abs(cosT), e) * signSP * pow(abs(sinP), e) * size
y = signST * pow(abs(sinT), e) * size
P = vec3(x, y, z)
N = normalize(vec3(pow(abs(x), max(squareness - 1.0, 0.1)) * signP, pow(abs(y), max(squareness - 1.0, 0.1)) * signST, pow(abs(z), max(squareness - 1.0, 0.1)) * signSP))
Cd = vec3(0.2 + 0.6 * abs(N.x), 0.3 + 0.6 * abs(N.y), 0.8)
publish = sin((t + 1.0) * speed)

param float size = 2.5 [0.5, 10.0]
param float height = 0.40 [0.0, 2.0]
param float freq = 2.5 [0.5, 8.0]
param float speed = 1.0 [0.0, 5.0]
x = (uv.x - 0.5) * size
z = (uv.y - 0.5) * size
dist = sqrt(x * x + z * z)
wave = sin(dist * freq - (t + 1.0) * speed)
y = wave * height * exp(-dist * 0.4)
P = vec3(x, y, z)
slope = cos(dist * freq - (t + 1.0) * speed) * freq * height * exp(-dist * 0.4)
nx = if(dist > 0.001, -(x / dist) * slope, 0.0)
nz = if(dist > 0.001, -(z / dist) * slope, 0.0)
N = normalize(vec3(nx, 1.0, nz))
Cd = vec3(0.15 + 0.35 * (y + 0.5), 0.55 + 0.4 * sin(dist * 3.0), 0.85)
publish = sin((t + 1.0) * speed)

param float wander = 1.7 [0.5, 3]
state float step = 0
if (tick(1/16) > 0.5) {
   d = floor(abs(sin(step * wander)) * 6)
   acc = if((step % 4) < 0.5, 1, 0)
   rest = if(rand() < 0.85, 1, 0)
   note(deg(d) - 12, (0.55 + 0.4 * acc) * rest, 1/16)
   step = (step + 1) % 16
}
